apple-200696147-3956.text:
Apple Vision Pro brought spatial computing to the world, and we're just getting started. The System UI team builds the experiences and system behaviors at the heart of visionOS, defining how people use vision products such as Apple Vision Pro every day.
We're looking for an engineer who is eager to learn and grow: someone who loves building interfaces that feel effortless, thrives on fast iteration with interface designers, and wants to help shape what spatial computing becomes next, from intelligent, context-aware system experiences to interactions that flow seamlessly across Apple devices.
As a system UI engineer, you'll build the applications and system behaviors that define the overall experience of our platform, ultimately shaping the way customers use our products. You'll take work from early concept through shipping software, iterating rapidly alongside designers to get every interaction, animation, and detail right.
You'll work with technologies such as SwiftUI, UIKit, RealityKit, and ARKit, along with a wide range of internal frameworks and services that let you build experiences deeply integrated into the operating system. We build with modern tools, including AI and agentic development tools, to move quickly from idea to polished experience without compromising on quality.
Design, build, and own system experiences on Apple’s vision products end-to-end, from early concept through shipping
Iterate rapidly with designers, refining interactions, motion, and detail through tight feedback loops
Build and evolve the architecture and frameworks that system experiences are built on
Profile and tune frame-rate, latency, power, and thermals so experiences feel fast and fluid
Build intelligent, context-aware system experiences powered by Apple Intelligence and on-device machine learning
Create experiences that work seamlessly across Apple Vision Pro and other Apple devices
Partner closely with UI frameworks, app, hardware and product, Apple Intelligence, and other platforms' system UI teams
Minimum Qualifications
BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience
0-3 years of professional software development experience
Experience with Swift through internships, projects, or professional work
Experience building UI with SwiftUI or UIKit
Comfortable and eager to use AI and agentic development tools in your daily work, with the judgment to review, test, and own the code they help produce
Strong communication and collaboration skills
Attention to detail, creativity, and passion for craft
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with RealityKit, ARKit, or other 3D and spatial frameworks
Experience with Swift concurrency, including async/await, actors, and Swift 6 strict concurrency
Proficiency in Objective-C or C++

The base pay range for this role is between $116,400 and $175,200, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

Apple's Camera ISP team is looking for a passionate and skilled embedded software engineer to help shape the future of imaging across all Apple products. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of hardware and software — building the low-level systems that power extraordinary camera experiences in iPhone, iPad, Mac, and beyond.
You'll be part of a close-knit, collaborative team that values innovation, rapid iteration, and technical excellence. We give our engineers meaningful ownership and autonomy, with direct impact on how Apple designs, tests, and manufactures its most beloved products. Our team fosters an environment of cross-functional collaboration, where your contributions influence decisions at both the team and product level.
This role involves developing camera software across many layers, including firmware, kernel, and user space. You will be responsible for helping to design, implement, maintain, and test new camera and ISP features across all Apple products.
This is a highly cross-functional product development role. You'll collaborate closely with Silicon Design, Camera Hardware, Media Frameworks, and QA teams — translating complex requirements into robust, high-quality implementations. The environment is multifaceted and fast-paced, and we're looking for someone who is self-directed, adaptable, and passionate about craftsmanship in software — with an eye toward reliability, performance, and maintainability.
Design and implement low-level drivers and system software for sophisticated image signal processing (ISP) pipelines in embedded environments, targeting Apple's latest SoCs and chipsets.
Develop camera features across the full software stack — from user-space frameworks and kernel drivers to firmware — for Apple products.
Partner with cross-functional teams to define features, communication protocols, and implementation specifications, with clearly documented requirements.
Develop system software for secure sensor subsystems powering features like Face ID and Optic ID.
Support hardware validation, factory testing, and manufacturing diagnostics to ensure product quality at scale.
Minimum Qualifications
BS and a minimum of 3 years relevant industry experience.
3+ years of relevant industry experience in embedded or systems software development.
Proficiency in C and C++.
Proficiency in developing real-time software in embedded environments.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in low-level software development, including hardware-software integration and debugging.
Familiarity with image signal processing (ISP) pipelines or camera systems.
Experience with macOS or iOS driver and kernel-level development.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to convey complex technical concepts clearly across teams.
Self-directed and adaptable — comfortable navigating ambiguity in a dynamic, fast-paced product environment.

Do you have a passion for invention and self-challenge? Do you thrive on pushing the limits of what’s considered feasible. As part of a world class modem team, you’ll craft sophisticated groundbreaking embedded firmware that deliver more performance in our products than ever before. You’ll work across fields to transform improved hardware elements into a single, integrated design. Join us, and you’ll help us innovate new cellular technologies that continually outperform the previous iterations! By collaborating with other product development groups across Apple, you’ll push the industry boundaries of what wireless systems can do and improve the product experience for our customers across the world. Do you want to have an impact on every single Apple product?
As a Wireless Firmware Engineer on the physical layer development team, you will be at the center of the embedded 5G/4G/multimode cellular firmware effort within a silicon design group responsible for designing and productizing state-of-the-art cellular SoCs.
This position requires someone comfortable with all aspects of embedded software design and development, that thrives in a dynamic cross-functional organization, is not afraid to debate ideas openly, and is flexible enough to pivot on constantly evolving requirements.
Specify, design, and develop the physical layer embedded software architecture of a state-of-the-art mobile wireless communications system.
Design, develop and optimize the cellular modem processing algorithms pertaining to Baseband and RF components in a cellular system.
Work with Baseband & RF systems and hardware designers to define hardware architecture and software computing requirements.
Work with cross functional teams to manage dependencies while driving the key Radio features.
Minimum Qualifications
BS and a minimum of 10 years relevant industry experience.
Knowledge of mobile communications in 4G/5G 3GPP protocols and physical layer & radio aspects
Solid understanding of Digital signal processing and RF fundamentals.
Solid understanding of software engineering principles, and core computer science fundamentals.
Excellent command of C and C++, and working experience with compilers, build and source code control tools.
Working knowledge of CPU architecture, HW/SW interfaces and memory management.
Proficiency with debugging in embedded software systems. Familiarity with JTAG and ETM Trace tools.
Knowledge of Communication theory, Wireless standards, Radio architecture and Interfaces
Preferred Qualifications
Previous working experience in a real time embedded product.
Previous working experience developing RFSW for a cellular Modem.
Previous working experience in MSIM RF arbitration or RF Ctrl.

apple-200696111-0836.text:
What if the payment infrastructure you built tomorrow processed millions of transactions by next quarter, across every Apple Store, the App Store, and an expanding universe of fintech partners worldwide? The Payments Engineering team sits at the core of Apple's Wallet, Payments, and Commerce organization, owning the foundational rails that make every transaction possible and pioneering capabilities like Tap to Pay on iPhone that redefine what a payment terminal can be. This is global-scale fintech work with real stakes, real complexity, and a direct line to how people spend and move money every day.
You will own meaningful slices of distributed systems that must stay available and performant under transaction volumes few engineers ever encounter, working alongside privacy and security teams to ensure correctness is never an afterthought. Each week brings a mix of deep design conversations, hands-on Java development, and cross-functional problem solving with quality, testing, and partner engineering teams whose success is inseparable from yours. The craft compounds here: the judgment you build navigating high-availability tradeoffs and asynchronous processing challenges at this scale accelerates you in ways that most engineering environments simply cannot replicate.
• Build and own core payment processing infrastructure that moves real transactions across the Apple Online Store, Retail, and App Store at global scale.
Architect distributed systems designed for fault tolerance, ensuring payment rails stay resilient under peak load and across failure scenarios.
Drive the full delivery cycle for critical components, from technical design through deployment, monitoring, and disaster recovery.
Shape privacy and security outcomes by partnering directly with security engineering to exceed compliance and data-protection standards.
Lead constructive design reviews that raise the technical bar across the team and accelerate the growth of fellow engineers.
Minimum Qualifications
Strong command of computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, concurrency models, and system design.
• Proven experience building high-availability, high-throughput distributed systems that operate reliably at significant transaction volumes.
Hands-on proficiency in Java or a JVM-based language (Kotlin, Scala) with production-grade code shipped and maintained.
Deep understanding of concurrent and asynchronous processing patterns, applied to real-world backend systems.
Track record of engaging across the full software development lifecycle, including design, testing, deployment, and on-call ownership.
Demonstrated ability to communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to cross-functional partners across engineering, privacy, and security.
Preferred Qualifications
Built or operated workflow orchestration pipelines (Temporal, Apache Airflow, or similar) in a production environment.
Shipped features backed by both relational and non-relational data stores, with informed choices about consistency and query performance tradeoffs.
Hands-on experience with message queue systems (Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ) in high-throughput, event-driven architectures.
Deployed and operated services on a major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including infrastructure-as-code and observability tooling.
Prior work in fintech, payments, or commerce, with direct exposure to transaction integrity, reconciliation, or regulatory compliance challenges.

Join Apple's Wireless System-on-Chip (SoC) design team to define next-generation modem architectures and develop cutting-edge physical-layer algorithms for products like AirPods, iPhone, and Apple Watch. You'll work on system modeling, design and simulation, collaborating with RF, antenna, firmware, and software engineers to transform wireless innovations from concept to reality.
Your responsibilities include wireless system design, simulation, and pre-/post silicon bring-up in the lab by collaborating with Radio/RTL/FW team as well as cross-functional teams to deliver the products that enhance end user experience.
Design comprehensive wireless system simulations modeling RF/PHY signals, channel behavior, and MAC/networking layers.
Invent physical-layer algorithms and embedded DSP solutions for wireless SoC architectures.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to derive, simulate, implement, and verify novel PHY features.
Create models and visualizations of system performance, including propagation, RF/antenna behavior, and protocol interactions.
Perform fixed-point design and generate RTL vectors for hardware implementation.
Conduct lab FPGA/silicon bring-up and RF/PHY/MAC testing with industry-standard equipment.
Minimum Qualifications
BS and minimum 10 years relevant industry experience.
Mastery of complex wireless systems with deep understanding of component dependencies and protocol layer interactions.
Expertise in DSP, wireless communications, and wireless chip development.
Strong software programming skills for RF/PHY modeling and MAC protocol simulation.
Proficiency in Matlab, C, and C++.
Preferred Qualifications
MSEE/Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering with Digital Communications & Signal Processing focus and minimum 10 years relevant industry experience.
Wireless standards organization or industry consortia participation.
Experience with large-scale field and simulation dataset processing.
Publications or patents in wireless communications or signal processing.
Fixed-point design and RTL vector generation experience.
Knowledge of analog/RF impairments in wireless systems.
Industry standards experience (e.g., Bluetooth, Ultra-Wideband, GPS).
Hands-on lab FPGA/silicon bring-up and PHY/RF/MAC testing experience.

apple-200696034-0836.text:
Join our team at the forefront of defending Apple's ecosystem. Our Mitigation Engineering team builds the large-scale machine learning systems that protect millions of users from emerging threats and ensures the integrity of our products.
We are looking for an experienced, senior Applied ML Engineer who has a proven track record of shipping production models. The ideal candidate is passionate about tackling complex safety and security challenges using state-of-the-art techniques, including methods that draw on a model's internal representations for mitigation purposes. In this role, you will design, build, and deploy the critical machine learning systems that are foundational to the safety of Apple's products, all while upholding our deep commitment to user privacy.
As a senior engineer on this team, you will own the full lifecycle of our abuse detection and safety guardrail models. You will partner closely with software, platform, and product teams to deploy robust, scalable defenses. We believe the most effective security systems are built by engineers who can translate adversarial insights into production-ready code. Your work will directly contribute to the architecture of Apple's AI platform and protect users from real-world harm.
Design, build, and deploy production-grade ML models to detect and mitigate risks across multiple modalities (text, image, audio) and languages
Own the modeling end to end: from prototyping and data analysis to deployment, monitoring, and the continuous improvement of models in production - this includes decisions such as probe based mitigation architectures, layer selection, calibration, and robustness
Drive the data strategy to continuously improve model performance by analyzing distribution gaps, contributing to synthetic data pipelines, and creating automated annotation systems
Work with platform and inference teams on how guardrail models are hosted across different model architectures and deployment targets, and shape modeling choices around latency, memory, and portability
Collaborate with cross-functional partners in engineering, research and product teams to define project requirements, establish technical direction, and deliver robust safety solutions
Minimum Qualifications
Proven experience shipping machine learning models to production. You have owned the end-to-end lifecycle of a model, from development to deployment and maintenance
Strong familiarity with research fundamentals, machine learning principles, and development methodologies around LLMs, foundation models, including how transformer internal states (activations) can be used to detect safety-relevant behavior
Proficient programming skills in Python and deep learning toolkits (e.g. JAX, PyTorch, Tensorflow)
Ability to work with sensitive and offensive content as part of building robust security and abuse detection systems
Preferred Qualifications
BS, MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or related fields or an equivalent qualification acquired through other avenues
5 years of experience shipping machine learning models to production systems
Hands-on experience with activation probing, representation-level or interpretability methods, or fine-tuning or aligning large language models for security or safety applications
Interest in or experience with deploying models and lightweight model heads across different architectures and hardware, such as on-device and server-side
Experience driving technical projects and collaborating with large, diverse, cross-functional teams

Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product and service we create results from us strengthening each other’s ideas. That happens because we believe we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better.
Do you want to push the limits of the best mobile phone camera in the world? The Creative Intelligence team features a diverse engineering roster, including software engineers, color and imaging scientists and ML experts. We work at a fast pace and require everyone to be highly self-motivated.
The Color Imaging and Standards team develops novel imaging technologies and new software features for the next generation of Apple cameras. Our goal is to improve image quality and enable new capture experiences by trying new things! We start by exploring new ideas, testing them by building proof-of-concept demos, reviewing images to confirm customer benefits, and then implementing the best ideas in our ecosystem.
We delivered algorithms that drive some of the iPhone cameras’ groundbreaking features, such as HDR photography. We are passionate about photography and strive to build new innovative features that let users unleash their creativity in ways they never thought possible – we want to work with people with the same desire!
We're looking for people who are passionate about cutting-edge photographic experiences. Join us to learn more about image quality, dive into our cameras' features, and explore new ideas!
We are looking for an enthusiastic imaging scientist who can help us build new camera technologies and experiences. This position focuses on the identification, exploration, and prototyping of image processing technologies for future Apple products.
You will work on small and large cross-functional projects and interface with other software and hardware engineering teams.
A successful candidate will not only need to identify new tech and be able to problem-solve outside of their respective technical area, but also educate a broad audience of people at Apple about their benefits and tradeoffs.
Inventing and implementing innovative image processing algorithms or user experiences.
Exploring novel imaging applications and features integrating hardware and software, demonstrating feasibility through modeling and prototyping.
Collaborating with your team members to prepare presentations, talks, and disclosures to explain your inventions.
Collaborating with other teams in software, firmware, and hardware to ensure the highest possible image quality.
Minimum Qualifications
Strong engineering background in color imaging, image processing, or image quality.
Deep knowledge of digital photography and camera components.
Prior experience prototyping new technologies, developing algorithms, and writing proof of concept software.
Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Strong presentation and communication skills.
M.S. or Ph.D. in Imaging, Color, Vision, Computer, Optics Science, EE, or equivalent with 3+ years of experience in a related field.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in HDR imaging, from capture to display, and tone mapping.
Knowledge of optics, signal processing, color perception, human vision system, and mathematical modeling.
Experience with digital photography, color, and imaging processing pipelines and architectural designs, including graphics and rendering
Capable of prototyping, conducting design of experiments, and analytical data processing.
Familiarity with ISO/ICC and related imaging standards.

There are job opportunities, and then there are career-defining moments. This might be yours.
The iCloud Compliance Engineering team builds the systems that help Apple meet its privacy and legal obligations across iCloud. We own the applications that retrieve user data from a wide range of Apple services, including iCloud, FaceTime, and iMessage.
In this role, you will build tools that operate at Apple scale, take on challenges such as platform modernization, and develop intelligent features that use generative AI. You will work with cutting-edge technologies available only at Apple.
Our team is in charge of maintaining and enhancing several systems that connect to various services to extract user-uploaded content such as photos, videos, emails, and documents. That data is then made available to users through Apple's Privacy Portal (privacy.apple.com).
What sets our team apart is its reach. We work with services across the full breadth of iCloud, which makes this a highly cross-functional role. You will get to collaborate with many teams across Apple. We partner closely with other engineering teams to understand their technical details. When new features or changes ship, we work with them to make sure Apple stays compliant with regulations. Having an inquisitive mind and asking questions will help you not only achieve immediate results but also inspire new ideas for your next killer feature.
At Apple Service Engineering, we're very invested in your personal growth. We will work with you to define your career goals and help you get closer to them with mentorship, training, and education.
Minimum Qualifications
3+ years experience in developing and maintaining high-performance, scalable backend systems using Java, with a strong understanding of design patterns and data structures.
Expertise in building robust, high-performance, responsive, and accessible user interfaces with a focus on usability and cross-platform compatibility.
Experience with designing and implementing efficient APIs and micro-services.
Experience with relational databases like Oracle, PostgreSQL, and NoSQL databases like Cassandra for efficient data storage and retrieval.
Proficient in applying best practices for clean, maintainable code.
Strong written and verbal communication skills to collaborate optimally with cross-functional teams.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with strong attention to detail.
Willingness to learn new technologies and comfortable with working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
BS in Computer Science or related field
Preferred Qualifications
Proficient in TypeScript, with expertise in modern JavaScript frameworks such as ReactJS, AngularJS, and VueJS.

apple-200695274-0836.text:
Our AIML Data Operations team helps deliver high-quality human-annotated and human-evaluated data for AI and machine learning. The Quality Assurance team develops the methods, tools, and metrics that help us measure quality, catch issues early, and improve how data is produced and evaluated at scale.
We’re looking for a hands-on software engineer to build the tools and data systems behind that work. You’ll automate QA workflows, build pipelines that turn annotation and review events into reliable metrics, and create dashboards and alerts that help teams act on those metrics. You’ll also analyze quality data to understand where errors occur and whether changes to guidelines, tools, or workflows improve outcomes.
You’ll own projects from problem definition through deployment and ongoing operation. A project might start with a question such as “Where are annotation errors increasing?” or “Is our audit sample giving us enough coverage?” You’ll work with QA, Data Science, Engineering, and Operations to define the measurement, build the workflow or pipeline, validate the results, and put them in the hands of the people who can act on them.
Build internal QA tools and automation for workflows such as audit sampling, gold dataset management, calibration, adjudication, and defect triage. Integrate these tools with existing annotation and review platforms.
Design and operate reliable data pipelines that combine annotation, human review, and automated QA outputs. Build in validation, monitoring, and support for backfills so reported metrics remain traceable and reproducible.
Develop dashboards and alerts that show quality, coverage, and emerging risks across projects and workflows. Enable users to trace an aggregate change to the relevant task types, error categories, and underlying examples.
Implement scalable quality measurement for accuracy, inter-annotator agreement, error rates, and audit coverage. Work with QA and Data Science to define denominators, minimum sample sizes, and alert thresholds.
Investigate quality regressions using SQL, Python, and statistical methods. Identify recurring failure modes, quantify their impact, and assess whether changes to guidelines, tooling, or workflows resolve them.
Evaluate automated QA methods against human-reviewed examples. Measure false positives, missed defects, and review effort to determine where automation can reliably support human review.
Own the systems you ship, including design, testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, and support. Use feedback from QA and Operations teams to prioritize improvements.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field.
Experience designing, building, and maintaining production software, internal tools, or data systems used by other teams.
Strong programming skills in Python and strong SQL skills for data transformation, validation, and analysis.
Experience building automated workflows or data pipelines that integrate multiple data sources or services.
Experience presenting data through dashboards, analytical applications, or reporting interfaces that support operational decisions.
Ability to investigate data discrepancies and translate ambiguous quality or operational questions into measurable outcomes.
Ability to work across technical and operational teams and explain findings and tradeoffs clearly.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with data annotation, human evaluation, ML data pipelines, or quality engineering for data-intensive products.
Familiarity with statistical sampling, confidence intervals, inter-annotator agreement, or measurement design for subjective tasks.
Experience evaluating rule-based or model-assisted QA against human judgments, including precision, recall, and error analysis.
Experience building systems for global operations or workflows with multiple sites and review teams.
